description:
Read the outcome of one schema check run: the overall status, and for each task in the run the composition errors, lint diagnostics, schema changes with the client operations they affect, downstream variant results, and custom check violations.
Get a check ID from GetSchemaChecks, from latestRevision.checkWorkflow.id in GetProposal (null if no check was triggered), or from the workflowID that RunSubgraphCheck returns.
Provide the graph ID and the check ID.
Read baseVariant before you compare the changes with another diff.
For a proposal's check, baseVariant can name the proposal variant, but the changes are measured against the source variant as of the proposal's creation or its last upstream pull, so they cover every revision of the proposal and leave out later upstream changes.
implementingServiceName may not match the subgraph whose changes are listed, so read the changes themselves.
numberOfCheckedOperations of 0 means no client operations were tested, not that none are affected.
An empty list of affected operations covers only operations seen in the graph's usage data, so it does not prove that a change is safe.
The affected operations are paged with affectedOperationsLimit and affectedOperationsOffset; the change list is capped by the server, and areChangesTruncated reports when that happened.
